theorem odd_power_factorial_growth_bounded_offset (n t : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) (ht : t ≤ n) : 3 * n ^ 2 ≤ (2 ^ (2 * (n + t) + 1) + 1) * Nat.factorial n := by
  have hexp : ∀ m : ℕ, 4 ≤ m → 3 * m ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ (2 * m + 1) := by
    intro m hm
    induction m, hm using Nat.le_induction with
    | base =>
        norm_num
    | succ m hm ih =>
        rw [show 2 * (Nat.succ m) + 1 = (2 * m + 1) + 2 by omega, pow_add]
        norm_num at *
        have hquad : 4 * m ≤ m ^ 2 := by
          have h := Nat.mul_le_mul_right m hm
          nlinarith
        have hpoly : 3 * (m + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 12 * m ^ 2 := by
          nlinarith
        nlinarith
  
  have hsum : 4 ≤ n + t := by
    omega
  
  have hbig := hexp (n + t) hsum
  
  have hsq : 3 * n ^ 2 ≤ 3 * (n + t) ^ 2 := by
    gcongr
    omega
  
  have hpow : 3 * n ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ (2 * (n + t) + 1) :=
    hsq.trans hbig
  
  have hfac : 1 ≤ Nat.factorial n := by
    have hpos := Nat.factorial_pos n
    omega
  
  have hmul :
      2 ^ (2 * (n + t) + 1) ≤
        2 ^ (2 * (n + t) + 1) * Nat.factorial n := by
    simpa using
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 ^ (2 * (n + t) + 1)) hfac

    3 * n ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ (2 * (n + t) + 1) := hpow
    _ ≤ 2 ^ (2 * (n + t) + 1) * Nat.factorial n := hmul
